---@type LoggerManager
local LoggerManagerNative = LoggerManager

local logLevel = 0
LoggerManagerNative.SetLoggerLevel(logLevel)

local function formatLog(...)
    local params = {}
    for i, v in ipairs({...}) do
        if type(v) == "table" and not v.__tostring then
            params[i] = table.show(v)
        else
            params[i] = tostring(v)
        end
    end
    return table.concat(params, "  ")
end

local function formatError(...)
    return formatLog(...) .. "\n" .. debug.traceback()
end


local Logger = class("LuaLogger")
Logger.s_instances = {}

function Logger.GetLogger(name)
    local logger = Logger.s_instances[name]
    if not logger then
        logger = Logger.new(name)
        Logger.s_instances[name] = logger
    end
    return logger
end

function Logger.SetLoggerLevel(level)
    for _, inst in pairs(Logger.s_instances) do
        if inst.m_loggerLevel == logLevel then
            inst:SetLevel(level)
        end
    end
    logLevel = level
    LoggerManagerNative.SetLoggerLevel(level)
end

function Logger:ctor(name)
    ---@type PluginSet.Core.Logger
    self.m_native = LoggerManagerNative.GetLogger(name)
    self.m_loggerLevel = logLevel
end

---SetLevel
---@param level number
function Logger:SetLevel(level)
    self.m_loggerLevel = level
    self.m_native:SetLevel(level)
end

function Logger:Debug(...)
    if self.m_loggerLevel <= 0 then
        self.m_native:Debug(formatLog(...))
    end
end

function Logger:Warn(...)
    if self.m_loggerLevel <= 1 then
        self.m_native:Warn(formatError(...))
    end
end

function Logger:Error(...)
    self.m_native:Error(formatError(...))
end

function Logger:Info(...)
    if self.m_loggerLevel <= 2 then
        self.m_native:Info(formatLog(...))
    end
end

return Logger
